reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text in p0001 expressly states no exclusive arrangement is created and that the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties — this meets the preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph.

Deterministic check confirms no requirements/sole-supplier obligation binds Customer, and the rationale correctly dismisses the other 'exclusive' references (non-exclusive license, exclusive jurisdiction, trademark ownership) as non-restrictive.
